items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He was playing alto with his father's band.

ctx.x: So in other words, he switched to tenor when he got in Bronson's because that's what Bronson wanted? He was playing alto right before Bronson, right?

He was playing alto with his father's band. So he left his father's band and went with Bronson. Any time he left his father, his father was taking everything he had. He took all the horns... Let's see, what did he have? He had a clarinet, a baritone and an alto -- those were the instruments -- and a soprano.
